World of Warcraft: Forever · beta 1.60.1 · Alliance 1-30

Forever Alliance Quest Atlas

Every quest Wowhead's Forever database marks as new or updated in the Alliance levelling zones, with givers, coordinates, XP, chains and rewards, pulled on 23 Sep 2026. The beta cap is 20, so 1-20 zones are well covered and 20-30 zones fill in as the cap rises; nothing past 30 exists yet. Coordinates come from Wowhead client sightings and can be a few units off.
